firm_data.firm_description: Kirby Aisner & Curley LLP combines decades of experience helping businesses and individuals achieve their goals, overcome financial and legal troubles and move forward with every possible advantage. They are committed to providing counsel and guidance with creativity, integrity and compassion.
notable_facts: The firm serves clients throughout New York City, Long Island, Westchester and Rockland counties and the lower Hudson Valley.
The firm's clients range from sole proprietors and family-owned businesses to small public companies.
The firm takes a team approach to client needs, with attorneys having expertise in specific areas.

email.subject: AI for Kirby Aisner & Curley LLP, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Dawn,

Your bankruptcy and real estate practice across New York City, Long Island, Westchester and the lower Hudson Valley handles the kind of high-stakes, multi-jurisdictional work that demands both precision and speed from a lean team.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with smaller practices. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on what matters most: client trust, accuracy, and efficiency without the overhead.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now meeting regional firms who want to compete smarter. I'd be happy to stop by your Scarsdale office to show how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping practices like yours do more with your current team.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
